brief: First match of a regular expression, with its groups
description: Searches <dataType> value for the regular expression and returns its first match with the text of its groups, or undefined if there is none. Use test for a boolean result.

parameters.description: The regular expression. A regexp literal (/a+b/ or "a+b"re), to_regexp(s), or compile<regexp>(r) is already compiled; any other regexp value is compiled for this call.
parameters.name: regexp

returns.description: The first match, or undefined if there is none.
